Hi Anna — thanks for the sample and the onboarding form. Short answer: we prefer vendor portal uploads for new suppliers, with email as an exception path during setup or for small one-off invoices. A few details below to help you decide.

High-level intake options (how other vendors choose):
- Portal (preferred): Fast, searchable, supports PO-stamping and auto-GL mapping. Immediate validation on required fields. Recommended for recurring billing.
- Email (fallback): Accepts PDFs/XLSX to ap-invoices@redwood.ai; our AP team manually reviews and uploads. Longer processing time; some fields must be in a specific place on the invoice.

Minimal required invoice fields (portal + email):
- Redwood PO number (if applicable)
- Vendor name and remit address
- Invoice date and unique invoice number
- Line-level description, qty, unit price, line total
- Invoice total and currency
- Vendor tax ID / VAT number (if outside US)

From a template perspective your sheet is close — two asks:
1) Add a PO column (we can accept empty when no PO).
2) Include a single column for "Bill to entity" (we have multiple legal entities; this helps route).

Marissa (AP) is looped to confirm exception rules and upload link; Priyom is copied for vendor activation checklist (remit verification + contract link). If helpful, we can share our portal sample CSV mapping.

Next steps:
- Anna: confirm whether BrightPath prefers portal setup or will rely on email initially.
- If portal: we'll send a provisioning link and brief onboarding checklist.
- If email fallback: please confirm the exact filename convention you can produce (so AP parsing rules can be tuned).

Quick notes from vendor activation perspective:

1) PO policy: We require PO stamping for any invoice tied to a purchase order. For SOW/contracted services billed monthly where no PO exists, AP will accept invoices but they must include the contract ID and the Redwood legal entity.

2) Portal provisioning: IT needs the vendor DUNS or tax ID to create the vendor record. Also: whitelist anna@brightpath.com in our inbound parser to avoid false rejections.

3) Exception SLA: If BrightPath opts to use email during onboarding, AP turnaround is 7 business days for the first 2 months; after that we expect portal adoption.

I'll kick off the vendor activation once Anna confirms which channel they prefer and sends DUNS/tax ID.
